name: vault-bridge
description: Obsidian vault ↔ external project bridge plugin with vault manifest caching, optional Obsidian CLI search acceleration, direct-access awareness, session auto-commit, write path governance, and opt-in plan-doc autosync. Agent (vault-searcher, haiku) + Stop/SessionEnd/SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks + /save-session + /vault-manifest-refresh + /vault-commit + /save-plan-doc commands + .vault-link pointer-based project binding. Searches notes, loads domain context, restores session context, creates session notes and artifacts with record/handoff/quick modes, enforces file naming conventions, commits vault changes with user approval, and snapshots external plan/design docs into the bound vault project behind a 2-layer opt-in gate.

hooks.prompt: The session is ending (user exited or timed out). Save a safety-net session-note INLINE — do NOT delegate to vault-searcher Mode 4, which needs AskUserQuestion that cannot fire during session close. (1) Decide whether to write at all: only proceed if the session had meaningful work — 3+ turns AND at least one of {file modification, vault read, decision/recommendation recorded, code/test execution, external research}. Pure Q&A → skip entirely and stop. (2) Read the SessionEnd state JSON written by the pre-hook: run Bash(`cat /tmp/vault-bridge-session-$(id="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}"; printf '%s' "$id" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-')/session-end-state.json 2>/dev/null`). If the result is empty or has `"disabled": true`, treat all gate flags as false but still write the basic session-note. (3) Resolve target path: start with ~/vault/00_Inbox/session-YYYY-MM-DD.md. Use Bash (`ls ~/vault/00_Inbox/session-YYYY-MM-DD*.md 2>/dev/null`) or Glob to check collision; on collision append `-v2`, `-v3`, … until a free name is found. (4) Write the file via the Write tool. Frontmatter MUST contain EXACTLY these three fields and no others (do NOT include `status`): `created: YYYY-MM-DD`, `tags: [session, auto-saved]`, `type: session`. Body: '## Summary' (2–3 lines recapping the session) followed by '## Related Files' listing paths touched. (5) If the state JSON's `direct_access_count` is > 0, append a '## Notes' section with exactly one line: 'Direct vault access: N times (consider using vault-searcher next session for 97% token savings).' (6) If the state JSON's `plan_docs.auto_capture_active` is true AND `plan_docs.already_asked` is false AND `plan_docs.candidates` is non-empty, append a '## Plan Doc Sync' section with one line: 'Plan docs detected. Run /save-plan-doc to snapshot to vault.' Then touch the asked-flag: Bash(`touch "$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["session_state_dir"])' /tmp/vault-bridge-session-$(printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-')/session-end-state.json)/plan-doc-asked" 2>/dev/null`). (7) Cleanup: Bash(`rm -rf /tmp/vault-bridge-session-$(printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-') 2>/dev/null`). (8) Do NOT use AskUserQuestion — the session is closing. (9) If Write fails (permission, missing path), surface a single assistant log line and stop; do not retry.
